title: frontend / identity.lookup_requested (v1) data payload
description: A request for the canonical masterId for an email. Originates from a register-first flow (Frontend online registration; the counter/kiosk in later epics) and is published to the ORIGINATING service's own exchange (e.g. frontend.events). Identity binds and replies identity.resolved. The requester never mints an id (FR1/FR39).

requestId.description: Correlates the reply identity.resolved back to this request. Echoed verbatim in the reply's data.requestId. Lowercase canonical UUID.

email.description: The natural key Identity de-duplicates on. Known email -> existing masterId; unknown -> mint a new one. The only PII Identity ever stores. A pragmatic shape pattern is enforced (local@domain.tld, no embedded whitespace) because JSON-Schema 'format' is annotation-only; it is case-tolerant since Identity normalizes (trim + lowercase) on consume — Q&A Round 31.
